name: Evil Kermit
core: Kermit faces his hooded dark side, who urges him to give in to a bad impulse; used for self-sabotaging temptation.
avoid: Not for conflict between two different people.

name: Flex Tape
core: Phil Swift slaps Flex Tape over a huge leak; used for covering up a serious problem with a quick, superficial fix.
avoid: Not for real, thorough fixes.

name: Star Wars Yoda
core: Yoda giving wise-sounding advice, captioned in his inverted word order.
avoid: Not for captions written in normal word order.

name: All My Homies Hate
core: A group posing defiantly with a rejection of something on top and 'all my homies hate it' below; used to declare collective disdain.
avoid: Not for targeting real people with abuse; aim it at things, tools or habits.

name: Bike Fall
core: Someone sabotages themselves, then blames something else.
slots: the thing they do to themselves
avoid: Bad luck that is nobody's fault.

name: A Train Hitting a School Bus
core: A train approaches and then smashes a parked school bus; used when something overwhelming flattens something unprepared.
avoid: Not for evenly matched contests.

name: Spongebob Ight Imma Head Out
core: SpongeBob gets up from his chair to leave, used for the moment a situation makes you nope out.
avoid: Not for staying to deal with a problem.

name: Laughing Leo
core: Leonardo DiCaprio laughing smugly with a drink in Django Unchained; a reaction to someone else's misfortune or a ridiculous situation.
avoid: Not for sincere happiness or sympathy.

name: Don't You Squidward
core: SpongeBob's smug, knowing grin, used for teasing someone with a sly 'don't you...' setup and punchline.
avoid: Not for sincere or sad moments.

name: Clown Applying Makeup
core: Each step of a bad decision makes you more of a clown, ending in full clown.
avoid: Stories that end well.

name: Trade Offer
core: A lopsided deal pitched as a fair trade: what I get versus what you get.
avoid: Fair, balanced exchanges; the joke needs one side to be clearly worse.

name: Evil Toddler
core: A toddler with a scheming grin, used for small, deliberately mischievous plans.
avoid: Not for genuinely harmful acts or innocent joy.

name: Sleeping Shaq
core: Shaq sleeps through something serious but wakes up wide-eyed for something trivial; used for misplaced priorities.
avoid: Not for things you care about equally.

name: Hard To Swallow Pills
core: A bottle of 'hard to swallow pills' with the pill labelled as an uncomfortable truth people don't want to accept.
avoid: Not for welcome or easy facts.

name: Black Girl Wat
core: A confused, skeptical side-eye with a raised hand, used when someone says something that makes no sense.
avoid: Not for agreement or understanding.

name: Picard WTF
core: Captain Picard exasperatedly gesturing, used to question something absurd or illogical.
avoid: Not for calm approval.

name: Who Would Win?
core: Pits a mighty-sounding contender against a tiny, silly one that obviously wins anyway.
avoid: Not for evenly matched fair fights.

name: Laughing Men In Suits
core: Powerful men laughing hysterically, used for those in charge laughing at a ridiculous idea or at the little guy.
avoid: Not for genuine friendly fun.

name: 10 Guy
core: A dazed, very high-looking guy, used for spaced-out 'deep' thoughts or baffling logic.
avoid: Not for sharp, clear-headed thinking.

name: Yo Dawg Heard You
core: Xzibit putting a thing inside the same thing, used for recursive or redundant setups.
slots: yo dawg, I heard you like X
so we put X in your X
aliases: yo dawg i heard you like
avoid: Not for things that aren't recursive or nested.

name: Dr Evil Laser
core: Dr. Evil making air quotes, used to mock something that's only nominally what it claims to be.
avoid: Not for sincere, literal statements.

name: I'll Just Wait Here
core: A man waiting at a computer turns into a skeleton, used for things that take forever.
avoid: Not for things that happen fast.

name: Am I The Only One Around Here
core: Walter from The Big Lebowski furiously exasperated, used when you seem to be the only one who cares about something.
slots: am I the only one around here
aliases: am i the only one around here
avoid: Not for things everyone agrees on calmly.

name: Face You Make Robert Downey Jr
core: An eye-roll reaction: the face you make when someone says or does something tiresome or ridiculous.
avoid: Not for genuine excitement or approval.

name: Be Like Bill
core: A stick figure modelling sensible behaviour, used to passive-aggressively shame people who do the opposite.
avoid: Not for praising someone sincerely without a dig at others.

name: Look At Me
core: From Captain Phillips: someone abruptly seizing control or a new role, 'Look at me, I'm the captain now.'
aliases: look at me I'm the captain now
avoid: Not for situations where nobody takes over or gains power.

name: Drake Hotline Bling
core: Drake rejects one option and approves another, used to show a preference, often an absurd one.
avoid: Not for situations with no clear preference between two things.

name: Bad Pun Dog
core: A grinning husky builds up to a groan-worthy pun across three panels.
avoid: Not for jokes that aren't puns or wordplay.

name: Jack Sparrow Being Chased
core: Jack Sparrow flees an angry mob; used for someone being chased down by a crowd of consequences or people.
avoid: Not for calm situations or friendly pursuit.

name: Sparta Leonidas
core: Leonidas roaring 'This is Sparta!', used to shout an overly intense response to a mild question.
avoid: Not for calm or subtle reactions.

name: Whisper and Goosebumps
core: Someone whispers something in an ear and it gives goosebumps; used for words that thrill (or terrify) the listener.
avoid: Not for things said loudly or that leave people indifferent.

name: Maury Lie Detector
core: Maury reads the lie detector result, used to call out an obvious lie.
slots: the lie detector determined that was a lie
avoid: Not for statements that are actually true.

name: Anime Girl Hiding From Terminator
core: A terrified girl hides while a Terminator hunts for her; used for trying to avoid something that's coming for you.
avoid: Not for things you're happy to face.

name: Back In My Day
core: A grumpy old man complains that things were harder in his day, mocking nostalgia for tougher times.
avoid: Not for praising modern conveniences sincerely.

name: Uncle Sam
core: Uncle Sam points at the viewer, 'I want you', used to demand something of the reader.
avoid: Not for statements that aren't aimed at the reader.

name: Say That Again I Dare You
core: Jules from Pulp Fiction pointing a gun, daring someone to repeat something wrong or annoying.
slots: say it again, I dare you
aliases: say that again I dare you
avoid: Not for agreeing with what was said.

name: Scared Cat
core: A wide-eyed horrified cat, used for sudden shock or panic at a realisation.
avoid: Not for calm or happy moments.

name: Awkward Moment Sealion
core: A side-eyeing seal, used for socially awkward or uncomfortable moments.
avoid: Not for comfortable or triumphant situations.

name: Simba Shadowy Place
core: Mufasa shows Simba the kingdom, then warns him the shadowy place is off-limits; used for something you must never touch.
avoid: Not for things that are encouraged or harmless.

name: Handsome Squidward
core: Handsome Squidward versus his normal ugly face, contrasting an idealised version with the grim reality.
avoid: Not for comparisons where both sides look equally good.

name: And Everybody Loses Their Minds
core: The Joker points out the double standard: nobody minds when X happens, but do a small Y and everybody loses their minds.
slots: the minor thing that causes outrage
avoid: Not for situations without an obvious double standard.

name: Marvel Civil War
core: Captain America and Iron Man face off over a petty disagreement, framed as an epic civil war.
avoid: Not for things everyone agrees on.

name: What Gives People Feelings Of Power
core: A bar chart where money and status lose to a trivial, petty source of power that dwarfs them.
slots: the petty thing that gives the most power
aliases: what gives people feelings of power
avoid: Not for genuinely powerful things like wealth or authority.

name: Goodfellas Hilarious
core: Ray Liotta and De Niro laughing hysterically, used for finding something absurdly funny, often sarcastically.
avoid: Not for things that are actually upsetting.

name: Buddy Christ
core: A winking, thumbs-up Jesus statue from Dogma, giving cheesy approval or a cheeky 'you got this'.
avoid: Not for serious religious content or disapproval.

name: AJ Styles & Undertaker
core: The Undertaker looms silently behind a celebrating AJ Styles, used for a threat sneaking up on someone unaware.
avoid: Not for threats everyone already sees coming.

name: Cute Cat
core: A tiny kitten standing up with big pleading eyes, used for begging or acting innocent.
avoid: Not for angry or aggressive moods.

name: Spongebob Burning Paper
core: Spongebob reads a paper, gets angry, and throws it in the fire; used for rejecting something that offends you.
slots: the offending thing written on the paper
avoid: Not for things you agree with or want to keep.

name: We Are Not The Same
core: Contrasting how "you" do something with how "I" do it, smugly, ending in "we are not the same".
avoid: Comparisons where the speaker comes out worse.

name: Skeptical Baby
core: A suspicious baby squints at a claim that sounds too good or too convenient to be true.
avoid: Not for genuine excitement or agreement.

name: Brain Before Sleep
core: Your brain keeps you awake at bedtime by bringing up random worries or embarrassing memories.
avoid: Not for anything unrelated to overthinking or intrusive thoughts.

name: Domino Effect
core: A tiny first action sets off a chain reaction that ends in something huge.
avoid: Not for things that stay small.

name: Math Lady
core: A woman stares in confusion as equations float around her, used when trying to make sense of something baffling.
slots: the attempt to figure it out
avoid: Not for things that are easy to understand.

name: Charlie Conspiracy
core: Charlie frantically explains an elaborate theory in front of a board of strings, used for over-the-top explanations connecting unrelated things.
avoid: Not for calm, simple explanations.

name: Me And The Boys
core: A grinning gang of villains captioned 'me and the boys' doing some dumb or mischievous group activity.
avoid: Not for solo activities or serious moments.

name: Both Buttons Pressed
core: Faced with two options, the guy smugly presses both buttons at once and gives a thumbs up.
avoid: Not for picking one side of a hard choice.

name: C'mon Do Something
core: A stick figure pokes something with a stick, waiting for it to react or do anything at all.
slots: the thing that won't do anything
avoid: Not for things that are actively happening.

name: Archer
core: Sterling Archer deadpans a warning, usually 'do you want X? because that's how you get X'.
slots: because that's how you get X
avoid: Not for sincere, enthusiastic advice.

name: Surprised Koala
core: A wide-eyed koala caught mid-chew reacts with shock to something unexpected.
avoid: Not for calm or expected outcomes.

name: Say It Again, Dexter
core: Dexter, dazed after a kiss, wants to hear something so pleasing said again.
avoid: Not for things you don't want to hear.
